items.title: Launch Close Assist to mid-market finance leaders
items.problem: Close Assist ships on 2027-03-03 with no pipeline: the mid-market finance audience does not know the product, and sales has 0 qualified opportunities for it.

drivers.statement: Revenue: sales needs 60 qualified opportunities for Close Assist in Q2 to hit the new-product bookings plan
Positioning: establish the brand in month-end close automation before two competitors launch in H1

items.outcome: By the end of March, 400 marketing-qualified leads from the target audience have entered the funnel and sales has accepted 60 of them as opportunities.
non_goals: Paid search outside the UK and Germany

items.title: 400 marketing-qualified leads from the target audience by 31 March
items.metric: MQLs with campaign 'q1-close-assist' and a finance title at 200–2,000-employee companies, from the CRM

items.title: Sales accepts 60 opportunities from the campaign by 30 April
items.metric: Opportunities with source campaign 'q1-close-assist' in stage 'accepted', from the CRM

items.title: Launch webinar with a live close demo
items.description: A 45-minute webinar on 2027-03-10 where a customer controller and our product lead run a live month-end close, with a registration page, a 3-email invitation sequence, and an on-demand recording.
items.benefit_hypothesis: We believe a live demo with a peer controller will convert better than ads; we will know when the webinar produces at least 200 of the 400 MQLs.

items.title: Webinar registration page is live with tracking
items.as_a: finance director at a mid-market company
items.i_want: a registration page that tells me in under a minute what I will see and lets me register with 4 fields
items.so_that: I can decide to attend from the invitation email

acceptance.then: it has exactly 4 form fields, loads in under 2 seconds on 4G in the page-speed test, and every registration creates a CRM contact with campaign 'q1-close-assist'
the confirmation email with a calendar file arrives within 5 minutes

items.title: Webinar copy and invitation emails are approved
items.i_want: the landing page copy and a 3-email invitation sequence written to the messaging brief
items.so_that: every channel says the same thing about the webinar

acceptance.then: the page copy and all 3 emails use the brief's headline and 3 proof points, and each email is under 150 words

acceptance.when: legal and the CMO review it
acceptance.then: both approvals are recorded in the copy doc by 2027-02-12

items.title: LinkedIn launch programme for UK and German finance leaders
items.description: Organic posts from the company page and two executives, plus a paid sponsored-content campaign targeted at finance titles in 200–2,000-employee companies in the UK and Germany, all driving to the webinar.
items.benefit_hypothesis: We believe targeted LinkedIn reach will fill the webinar; we will know when LinkedIn sources at least 50% of webinar registrations.

items.title: Six launch-week posts are scheduled with tracking
items.i_want: 6 LinkedIn posts for launch week scheduled from the company page and the two executive accounts
items.so_that: we reach 40,000 impressions in the target audience during launch week

acceptance.given: the approved post copy and images
acceptance.then: all 6 appear in the scheduler between 3 and 7 March and every link carries utm_campaign=q1-close-assist

items.title: Paid campaign runs within budget and targeting
items.i_want: a sponsored-content campaign for finance titles at 200–2,000-employee companies in the UK and Germany
items.so_that: the webinar reaches buyers outside our followers

acceptance.given: a budget of 18,000 EUR for 3–28 March
acceptance.then: daily spend stays at or below 750 EUR and the audience estimate is between 150,000 and 250,000 members

acceptance.given: the campaign has run for 7 days
acceptance.then: any ad with a click-through rate below 0.4% is paused and replaced within 2 business days

items.title: Campaign dashboard shows leads and opportunities by source
items.i_want: a dashboard of registrations, MQLs, and accepted opportunities by source for campaign 'q1-close-assist'
items.so_that: I can move budget between channels weekly

acceptance.when: the dashboard refreshes each morning at 07:00
acceptance.then: it shows registrations, MQLs, and accepted opportunities for each of the 4 sources, and its MQL total matches the CRM report within 1%

items.title: Sales follows up every webinar lead within one business day
items.description: A shared follow-up play for the mid-market sales development team: routing rules, a call script built on the webinar demo, and a 1-business-day follow-up commitment for every MQL from the campaign.
items.benefit_hypothesis: We believe fast, demo-specific follow-up will turn webinar interest into opportunities; we will know when at least 15% of campaign MQLs become accepted opportunities.

items.title: Every campaign MQL is routed and called within one business day
items.i_want: campaign MQLs routed to me by territory with the webinar call script attached
items.so_that: I call each lead while the demo is fresh

acceptance.when: it is created in the CRM
acceptance.then: it is assigned to an SDR in its territory within 15 minutes, with the call script linked

acceptance.when: sales leadership reviews it each Monday
acceptance.then: at least 90% of last week's campaign MQLs show a logged call within 1 business day

items.title: Invitation email 2 links to the old registration page
items.observed: The 'Register now' button in invitation email 2 points to /webinars/close-2026, which returns 404; 312 recipients clicked it on 2027-02-24.
items.expected: Every link in the sequence opens the live registration page (S-1.1).
steps: Open the scheduled invitation email 2 in the email tool

acceptance.when: each of its 4 links is clicked in the test send
acceptance.then: all 4 open the live registration page with utm_campaign=q1-close-assist

acceptance.given: the 312 people who clicked the broken link
acceptance.then: each receives a correction email within 24 hours
